title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closed the US session at $64,041, clinging to a modest 0.3% gain inside a Fear & Greed reading of 26. The network’s hashrate sits at 864.9 EH/s, confirming miners remain fully committed even as sentiment stays defensive. Mempool congestion hit 93,360 transactions with fees as low as 2 sat/vB, signaling steady demand without fee spikes.
